description: This Java source file defines a singleton class DemoModeFilter that implements the RestAssured Filter interface. It intercepts HTTP requests in a demo mode environment and provides deterministic, fake responses to simulate server behavior without initiating real network calls. The filter handles specific endpoints such as authentication validation and job titles management, returning appropriate mocked responses based on request methods and parameters.
